items.memoText:
VETO MESSAGE - No. 43
 
TO THE ASSEMBLY:
 
I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill:
 
Assembly Bill Number 7011-A, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to  amend  the  public health law, in relation to allowing
      individuals to register in  the  "donate  life  registry"  through
      mandatory electronic personal income tax filings"
 
    NOT APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would  include  mandatory  electronic  personal income tax
filings as an approved method by which individuals could register as  an
organ, eye, and/or tissue donor.
 
  I  support the goal of this bill, which is to expand opportunities for
New Yorkers to register to  become  organ,  eye,  and/or  tissue  donors
through New York's Organ Donor Registry. Previously, New York had one of
the  lowest organ donor registry enrollment rates in the county, leaving
thousands of New Yorker's waiting for a life-changing  transplant.  Last
year,  however,  I announced that more than half of eligible New Yorkers
have registered to become donors, a major milestone for New York.
 
  However, this bill raises fiscal  and  operational  concerns  for  the
Department  of  Taxation and Finance. Further, many people do not submit
their own tax returns but rather do so through  a  tax  professional  or
third-party software.
 
  Therefore, I am constrained to veto this bill.
 
  The bill is disapproved.                       (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                               __________
